content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
UserAssistMenuItem
Menu item name linked to the launched application.
UserAssistLaunchCount
Number of times an application has been launched.
UserAssistLastRunTimeStamp Most recent time an application has been launched.
UserAssistRunTime
Time duration in milliseconds an application was running.
UserSecurityDomain
Domain for the file/process/registry owner (mapped from SID).
UserAssistRegistryId
UserName
Operating system username.
SessionId
Value that indicates the Terminal Services session identifier associated with the token.
UserAssistMenuFolder
Name of user-assisted menu folder which contains launched application link.
